items.title: Nvidia is cheap on paper, so why won't the market buy it?
items.summary: Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including Nvidia giving back about half of its Jensen Huang rally and why a stock growing sales 60% to 70% can trade at 10 times earnings, whether the Alice Wong affair was a "hit job," and what next week's Senate testimony means for the stock.

items.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.

items.title: Amazon and Meta are negotiating the future of AI shopping. Consumers aren't quite there yet.
items.summary: Meta's Muse could be headed to Amazon. That doesn't mean people will use it to make purchases.

items.title: Amazon, Meta reportedly in talks to remove block on Muse AI agent
items.summary:
Amazon (AMZN) and Meta Platforms (META) are reportedly in talks to remove Amazon's block on the Muse AI agent and allow it to conduct purchases on the e-commerce platform, according to Fortune.

The 8:30 team is joined by BD8 Capital Partners CEO Barbara Doran to discuss the significance of this for online retail spending.

items.title: Meta Says Muse “Raises Conversions for Advertisers.” It Already Places 51% of AI Agent Orders
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMeta was behind 51% of the AI agents placing orders over the past week, ahead of SpaceX’s Grok at 24%, and Muse can now shop Walmart’s Black Friday deals. A senior Meta executive says Muse raises conversions on the ads Meta already sells, so ads inside the agent can wait.
